label: TP
reason: Both alerts represent genuine vulnerabilities. Alert 1 (java/insecure-randomness): Line 92 uses java.util.Random().nextInt() for generating rememberMeKey - cryptographically weak RNG for session tokens. Alert 2 (java/xss): User-provided header values flow through doSomething() into bar variable and are concatenated into response output without HTML encoding - direct XSS path confirmed. The param originates from HTTP headers (line 63), passes through doSomething() transformations preserving user control, and reaches the response writer at lines 101-106 without sanitization.
